# AFJS Trust (All For Joyful Smiles)

> AFJS Charitable Trust is a registered non-profit in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India. It supports underprivileged children and families through education, girl empowerment, food and nutrition, and family welfare. Donations are accepted online (Razorpay) with 80G tax exemption for Indian donors.

Registration: GJ/2025/0719739. Contact: Afjs.charitable@gmail.com, +91 63573 69174 (WhatsApp available).
